judgments.reason: The support_span describes the clinical presentation (erythematous nodules in inguinal folds), which establishes the cutaneous/anatomical location but does not support the E. coli etiology component of the modifier. The span only partially supports the full modifier label and does not clinically support the complete 'due to E. coli infection' qualifier.

The support_span 'Bacterial culture: Positive for E. coli' occurs literally in the vignette and directly supports the etiologic modifier 'due to E. coli infection' as part of the completed diagnosis label.
